items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: I would say George. George is the man I always liked on clarinet. George Lewis.

ctx.x: What about clarinet players? Who were the best in those days?

Well, the clarinet player? Well, I think, let's see, well, let's see who I got on clarinet there I used to like so much was, well, I would say George. George is the man I always liked on clarinet. George Lewis. George Lewis. Yeah. I liked the George on.
Do you remember any of the men before him like T.O. or Bach K?
